claims.text: Park Hyatt Shenzhen is in the Futian business district of Shenzhen.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Shenzhen is a sophisticated 5-star hotel in the heart of the Futian business district.

claims.text: Guestrooms are on floors 36 through 44 and have floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: Guestrooms span floors 36 through 44, fitted with floor-to-ceiling windows

claims.text: Guestrooms have a dressing zone separated by French sliding doors, a separate bathtub and rain shower, and a powder room with an automatic washlet.

findings.quote: distinct dressing zone separated by French sliding doors, separate bathtub and rainshower, powder room for privacy with automatic washlet

claims.text: Each room has a Nespresso coffee machine.

findings.quote: Each room comes with 500-thread-count linen and down duvet, 55-inch LED TV with an extensive selection of TV programs and a Nespresso coffee machine.

claims.text: Garden Pavilion serves Cantonese cuisine.

findings.quote: Come and experience the heritage and innovation of Cantonese cuisine

claims.text: In the evening a live DJ plays in the Living Room.

findings.quote: As the sun dips below the horizon, the atmosphere shifts to a modern rhythm curated by our live DJ.
findings.note: Living Room section, evening live DJ

claims.text: The Attic has a private KTV room for parties and celebrations.

findings.quote: the sophisticated KTV room provides the perfect setting for high-end parties and bespoke celebrations
findings.note: The Attic section, KTV room for parties and celebrations

claims.text: Pool Terrace offers alfresco barbecue dining and cocktails on Level 8, next to the swimming pool.

findings.quote: Alfresco dining with barbecue and selected cocktails on Level 8, adjacent to the Swimming Pool.

claims.text: The fitness center overlooks the indoor pool and has a steam room.

findings.quote: Overlooking the indoor pool and stunning city views, the Fitness Center at Park Hyatt Shenzhen features a relaxing steam room
findings.note: indoor pool view and steam room

claims.text: Signature treatments at The Spa include restorative massages aimed at deep stress and muscular tension.

findings.quote: Signature wellness experiences include restorative massage techniques curated to alleviate deep stress and muscular tension

claims.text: Nearby places to explore include Lianhuashan Park and Shenzhen Bay Park.

findings.quote: there’s plenty to explore, including Lianhuashan Park, Shenzhen Bay Park

claims.text: Self-parking is complimentary for hotel guests.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Shenzhen offers complimentary self-parking for guests.

claims.text: The Glasshouse restaurant is on the 47th floor under a glass ceiling, with 270-degree views of the Shenzhen skyline.

findings.quote: Perched on the 47th floor, The Glasshouse is a sun-drenched sanctuary under a magnificent glass ceiling, offering panoramic 270 degree views of the Shenzhen skyline.

claims.text: The guestrooms were designed by Yabu Pushelberg, with custom-made furniture and art.

findings.quote: Designed by renowned designer Yabu Pushelberg, all guestrooms feature unique custom-made furniture and art

claims.text: The Attic bar is at the top of the hotel and has an extensive collection of premium gins.

findings.quote: The Attic is a “speakeasy-esque” bar, located at the apex of the hotel.
the bar boasts an extensive collection of premium gins and curated spirits

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has its own private spa treatment room.

findings.quote: Indulge in complete relaxation at the private personal spa treatment room

claims.text: The Sky View Deluxe corner rooms look out over the Shenzhen landscape and the bay.

findings.quote: Spacious 55 sq m room located at the corner of the building tailored with floor-to-ceiling windows and expansive skyline views, indulge in the panoramic views of the Shenzhen landscape and bay.
findings.note: corner room with landscape and bay views

findings.quote: Guests booking rooms in 1 King Bed with Sky View Deluxe can enjoy benefits include
findings.note: names the room Sky View Deluxe

claims.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in mainland China.

findings.quote: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

claims.text: The swimming pool is indoors.

findings.quote: Overlooking the indoor pool and stunning city views

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban location may lack resort-style outdoor spaces.
